newsitem.title: USA: Delmarva Power extends preferred offer.
newsitem.headline: Delmarva Power extends preferred offer.

text.p: Delmarva Power & Light Co said Monday it has extended the expiration of its offer to purchase to purchase its preferred stock for cash to October 4 to provide additional disclosures at the request of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Company officials were not immediately available to say what additional information was requested.
The offer to purchase dated August 21 was scheduled to expire Friday, the utility noted.
It said the prices offered with respect to each series of preferred stock covered by the offer remain unchanged.
A supplement to the offer, dated September 20, will be disseminated to holders of the preferred.
A preliminary count showed that the following shares had been tendered in response to the offer at its original expiration time --
-- 8,918 shares of the 3.70 percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 17.8 percent of those outstanding.
-- 18,299 shares of four percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 45.7 percent of those outstanding.
-- 23,812 shares of the 4.20 percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 47.6 percent of those outstanding.
-- 19,354 shares of the 4.28 percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 38.7 percent of those outstanding.
-- 29,561 shares of the 4.56 percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 59.1 percent of those outstanding.
-- 30,320 shares of the five percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 37.9 percent of those outstanding.
-- 165,000 shares of the 6-3/4 percent Preferred Stock ($100 par value), representing 82.5 percent of those outstanding.
-- 1,268,471 shares of the 7-3/4 percent Preferred Stock -- $25 Par, representing 79.3 percent of those outstanding.
-- and 9,650 shares of the Adjustable Rate Preferred Stock, Series A ($100 par value), representing 6.0 percent of those outstanding.
